video.title: Palestine's World Cup Journey
video.description:

The Palestinian national football team has carried a bigger weight than almost any other. They are a national team without a nation, flying a flag still unofficially recognised.

Yet they stand on the verge of joining football’s elite by qualifying for the FIFA World Cup.

This is their journey to World Cup 2026 qualification.

Written by James Montague, illustrated by Craig Silcock.
